body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target may move 1 unit away from a visible enemy; choose one target to gain +1 Fortitude against that enemy until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: All targets gain the defensive bonus.

rider.title: Authority - Formation
rider.html: Spend this Authority when a retreating creature would become Prone before your next turn: suppress that Prone effect until the triggering Action ends, then allow it to resume.
